description: This file defines an abstract class 'DeviceRequest' that manages requests for Zigbee devices, including execution flow and logging, serving as a base for more specific device request implementations.

classes.name: DeviceRequest
classes.description: Abstract class representing a request for a Zigbee device, providing execution logic and requiring subclasses to define specific device request behaviors.

methods.name: DeviceRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing request ID, device EUI64, and response type.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the request on a specific device. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the device request by retrieving the device and calling the appropriate methods based on device status.
